betti_0.expected_behavior: Should be 1 for a singular Phase Packet.

betti_1.description: Number of holes or cycles (1D homology).
betti_1.theoretical_mapping: Stable periodic internal structure or structural enclosure.

active_fraction.description: Fraction of total nodes/pixels above threshold.

persistence_landscape.description: Betti-0 and Betti-1 values swept across thresholds.
